card.name: If or When opening a conditional step
card.fires_on: The words "If" or "When" that start a new sentence in step-by-step handling or preparation instructions, right before a phrase like "using" or "used".

modes.label: If using a product
modes.description: Sentence-initial "If" introducing a condition about which product or device form is being used.
